授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）: 非平衡性が重要な役割を果たす物理現象とその理論的な取り扱いの基礎を学ぶ. (Brown運動，確率過程，揺動散逸定理，Onsagerの相反定理，線形応答理論，ゆらぎの定理など)
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）: We will study physical phenomena in which non-equilibrium nature plays an important part, and the basics of their theoretical treatment. Specifically, we will study Brownian motion, stochastic processes, fluctuation-dissipation theorem, Onsager's reciprocal relation, linear response theory, fluctuation theorems, and so on.
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.キーワード:
非平衡、ダイナミクス、ゆらぎ，Brown運動，確率過程，揺動散逸定理，Onsagerの相反定理，線形応答理論，ゆらぎの定理
Non-equilibrium, dynamics, fluctuation, Brownian motion, stochastic processes, fluctuation-dissipation theorem, Onsager's reciprocal relation, linear response theory, fluctuation theorems
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.履修条件:
学部レベルの力学(解析力学)，量子力学，統計力学の知識を前提とする.
Knowledge of mechanics (analytical mechanics), quantum mechanics and statistical mechanics at the undergraduate level is required.
